estimands.population: the complete frozen 384-scenario eligible retained manifest in SHA-256 scenario order
estimands.delta: average conditional mean over that ordered manifest of BC_i minus OM_i
estimands.om: average conditional mean over that ordered manifest of OM_i
estimands.heterogeneity: conditional means may change arbitrarily by scenario and motif
estimands.adapted_sequence: each paired outcome is bounded and measurable after its frozen scenario call; its conditional mean is taken relative to all prior scenario outcomes and frozen pre-call state
estimands.cross_scenario_dependence: no independence or common-mean assumption; dependence through the past filtration is allowed, while future scenario outcomes and provider randomness are unavailable at the current call

method.name: exact-mixture empirical-Bernstein confidence sequence

source.title: Closed-form empirical Bernstein confidence sequences for scalars and matrices
source.deciding_result: Proposition 3.1 exact mixture confidence sequence for the running average of bounded, possibly time-varying conditional means

method.delta_transform: Y_i=(BC_i-OM_i+1)/2 in [0,1]; map confidence limits back by 2*m-1
method.I: I(y;v)=integral from -1 to 1 of exp(y*z-v*z^2) dz
method.confidence_set: m in [0,1] such that I(sum_i X_i-t*m;U_t) < kappa*Z*sqrt(2*pi)/stream_alpha
method.primary_integral: analytic completion-of-square formula using IEEE-754 binary64 erf
method.independent_integral: composite Simpson quadrature with 16384 even subintervals
method.inversion: symmetric root in nonnegative y by 80-step bisection after power-of-two bracketing

looks.prefix_rule: a prefix average never binds a branch about the complete frozen manifest

decision.PROMOTE_TO_COORDINATION_STAGE: delta_lower > -0.10 AND om_lower >= 0.80 AND every deterministic hard gate passes
decision.MODEL_INTERFACE_FAIL: delta_upper < -0.10 AND om_lower >= 0.80 AND every deterministic hard gate passes
decision.INCONCLUSIVE_OR_UNDERFUNDED: none of the other scientific branches holds

missingness.pair_rule: any unresolved transport state in any of six calls makes the complete BC/OM scenario pair missing
missingness.joint_enumeration: Cartesian product of the four paired completions at the exact missing scenario positions
missingness.branch_invariance: report a scientific branch only if identical for every joint completion; otherwise TRANSPORT_INCONCLUSIVE

placement_algorithms.uniform_hash_positions: lowest SHA-256 integer of length-framed seed, scenario_id, MISSING-POSITION-r8

association_algorithms.BC_FAILURE_ENRICHED: sort by BC ascending then uniform placement hash
association_algorithms.OM_FAILURE_ENRICHED: sort by OM ascending then uniform placement hash
association_algorithms.DISCORDANT_ENRICHED: sort by abs(BC-OM) descending then uniform placement hash

operating_characteristics.rng: SHA-256 counter stream; seed is length-framed global seed, cell_id, replicate decimal; each digest is four big-endian unsigned 64-bit uniforms divided by 2^64
operating_characteristics.categorical_sampling: inverse CDF in fixed order p00,p01,p10,p11 with half-open intervals and last-cell closure

cost.why_equal: 96 and 192 are diagnostic only, so no scientific early stop exists
cost.paid_authorization: separate owner decision after endpoint, snapshot, tokens, prices, reliability, and dollar ceiling are frozen

transport_readiness.six_call_independence_mapping_only: per_call_failure <= 1-(1-0.02)^(1/6); dependence is not assumed for the deciding gate
transport_readiness.deciding_gate: one-sided exact Clopper-Pearson 95 percent upper bound for every registered endpoint failure mode, union-bounded across six call positions, is within pair budget
transport_readiness.clopper_pearson: invert Binomial(n,p) CDF at observed failures using deterministic bisection
transport_readiness.no_paid_claim: a route soak is called no-paid only if the frozen provider route has a genuinely zero-price primitive; otherwise it belongs in the later authorization cost

delta_all_zero_n384.input: 384 copies of 0 transformed to 384 copies of 0.5

low_discord_deterministic.input: four 01, four 10, and 376 equal pairs in fixed interleaving
